LEVEL_07.title: Bad Luck

LEVEL_08.title: Unstunned Waves
LEVEL_09.description: All Bizarre Fragment Negative Relic effects are increased.
LEVEL_09.title: Path of Pain

LEVEL_10.title: Hard Mode
